pages.title: Getting around
paragraphs: Walk with {move.forward}, {move.left}, {move.backward} and {move.right}, and look about with the mouse or the right stick. Hold {run} to run, press {jump} to jump and {crouch} to crouch.
Running, fighting and guarding spend stamina, the green bar. It refills on its own once you have been still for a moment.

pages.title: Fighting
paragraphs: Ready or sheathe your weapon with {toggle-weapon}. Press {attack} for a quick blow that chains into the next, or hold it to charge a heavy one. Hold {block} to guard and press {kick} to kick.
Equip armour and a weapon you are skilled with. A weapon your training does not cover rarely finds its mark, and a stronger metal hits harder.
Every attack also adds fatigue. Only rest and magic take fatigue away, and a tired fighter has less stamina to spend.

pages.title: Using the world
paragraphs: Aim at something and press {interact} to use it: open a door, take an item, search a body or speak to someone.

What use does depends on the activation mode: steal {activation.steal}, grab {activation.grab}, look at {activation.info} or talk {activation.talk}. The mode in force is shown at the bottom right of the screen.

pages.title: Your character
paragraphs: Open your inventory with {inventory} to equip, use and drop what you carry, and your character sheet with {character} to see your attributes and skills.
Skills rise as you use them. When enough of your career's skills have risen, you gain a level.
Open your spellbook with {spell}. Cast the readied spell with {recast}, or abort it with {abort-spell}. Use an enchanted item with {use-magic-item}.

pages.title: Resting
paragraphs: Rest with {rest} to recover health, magicka and fatigue. Enemies close by will not let you rest, and indoors you need a room at an inn or the leave of a guild you belong to.

pages.title: Finding your way
paragraphs: The map {map} shows the place you are in. Your logbook {logbook} keeps the quests you have taken, and the notebook {notebook} your own notes.
The travel map {travel-map} shows the Iliac Bay. Travel and transport {transport} takes you to any place you have heard of, by foot, horse, cart or ship, at the cost of the days on the road.

pages.title: Saving
paragraphs: Quick save with {quick-save} and quick load with {quick-load}. The game menu, opened with {menu}, saves and loads named games and holds the settings, where every control can be changed.

tutorial.offer: A short tutorial walks you through your first steps, a page at a time while you play.

pages.title: Your first steps
paragraphs: This tutorial shows a page at a time while you play. Read on to carry on playing; the next page follows shortly. End it whenever you like, and take it again from Help.
Walk with {move.forward}, {move.left}, {move.backward} and {move.right}, and look about with the mouse or the right stick. Every control can be changed: open the menu with {menu} and choose Settings.

pages.title: Arm yourself
paragraphs: Open your inventory with {inventory}. Put the best weapon you are trained in into your hand and any armour you carry onto your body.
A weapon your training does not cover, or one of weak metal, will seldom land a blow.

pages.title: Fighting
paragraphs: Ready or sheathe your weapon with {toggle-weapon}. Press {attack} to strike, hold {block} to guard and press {kick} to kick.
Every blow spends stamina, the green bar, which refills when you stop to catch your breath.

pages.title: The command radial
paragraphs: Press {radial} for the command radial. From it you ready your weapon, choose how you use what you touch (grab, look, talk or steal) and reach your spells, map, travel and rest.
Its centre tells you where you are, the date and the hour, and what you hold ready.

pages.title: Resting
paragraphs: When your health, stamina or magicka run low, rest with {rest}. You cannot rest with enemies near, and the guards will not let you sleep in the streets: take a room at an inn.

pages.title: Magic
paragraphs: If you know spells, open your spellbook with {spell} and cast one from it. A spell aimed at a target is loosed where you look, and {recast} casts your last spell again.
Creatures often resist magic, so keep a weapon to hand.

pages.title: Saving
paragraphs: Save often. Open the menu with {menu} and choose Save, or save at once with {quick-save}.

pages.title: Out of the cave
paragraphs: Your first task is to find your way out of this cave. Some doors look like the stone walls around them, so try any wall that seems out of place.
Open doors, treasure piles and the bodies of the fallen with {interact}, and take what they hold into your pack.

pages.title: Choose your fights
paragraphs: Some creatures can be hurt only by stronger metal: an imp shrugs off iron, so carry steel or better.
You need not fight everything. Run from what you cannot beat: your skills grow by using them, not by slaying the strongest foe.
That is all. The rest is under Help in the menu. Good fortune.
